storia de oɗoginta fœminis veneficis Ascalone

quia fœminæ proruperant ad veneficia.

Plurimi Rabbini memorantur quòd essent

Abba Chelchia & Chanina in Ɩuchas. fol.20.1. &
R. Chanina Ben Dufa, de quo admiranda refe-
runtur in Bab. Beracot fol.33.34. Vid. Iuchasin
